scope: Service and generic tracker associations route declared dotted reads/writes using definition-site permissions, use-site effects and original accessor receiver. Reversible extension removal restores own fields; ordinary Context metadata inherits through shadow extensions.
python_adaptation: Full accessor hooks receive explicit context plus receiver: get(context,receiver,error), set(context,value,receiver,error). Existing shorter hooks retain their legacy spelling.
verification_scope_reason: Reflect/Service/Context provider changes checked against unchanged Source journeys and direct injection, trace, effects, Connection and Typert consumers, plus Fiber/profile/Web/HMR regressions. No complete or release qualification.
remaining: Logger severity, remaining core lifecycle and canonical boot recomposition; C1-C9 not yet accepted.
